cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm entirely ready for our audition results. I'll supervise the waiting. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. May I carry on? It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved. I'll set the pace. Four in, six out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we also write down who we'll call if we don't get in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may. Give me the pen first; a supervisor should have her support network arranged before anyone else's.
